definition: Fraction of coordinates NOT close to zero in BF16(theta_t)-BF16(theta_0), using torch.isclose(delta_bf16, zeros_bf16, atol=1e-5). This reproduces the author's BF16 subtraction and tolerance comparison.
l2_definition: L2 of exact differences between stored BF16 values, subtracting after conversion to FP32; no FP32 master weights are used.
parameter_population: All unique HF model parameters; tied lm_head is counted once via model.embed_tokens.weight; no vocabulary padding.
implementation: Stream all stored BF16 coordinates, prefilter bitwise-identical values, and apply the author's BF16 subtraction/isclose criterion to the remaining coordinates. Identical values contribute zero changes.
